label: belgium-check
_why: Belgium as a hand-checkable case: two or three states in 1836, so the scenario's supply and demand can be validated by eye against the game. Belgium was never in the scoped market sweep, so it has no order book yet. n=3 to average, and this also cross-checks the pop split the telemetry reports.
_note: until = 1836.6.1, NOT 1836.4.1. active_pms rides phase 3, which fires three months after the date it stamps, so a 1836.2.1 dump emits at 1836.5.1 - an earlier run of this shape silently discarded that block entirely. Rule: until >= last dump + phase + 1 months.
